density.how: Count what the user's content needs, take the densest category any count points to, then check the fit: step down if a label needs more than 2 lines, overlaps a connector or forces a gap below the spacing spec; step up if the larger sizes still fit with every gap intact. Larger is preferred when it fits.

counts.nodes: device or system boxes (title tag + icon)
counts.labels: every text item except the title: tags, device labels, arrow labels, notes

node_styles.source: Figma ❑ Architectures › Template › Icon + Content design (frame 3271:31036); reference image in the architecture templates (section "templates", Icon + content design). Figma's Outfit font and untokened greys are replaced by the tokens below; the device tag stays light blue (decision architecture-brand-on-outcome).
node_styles.choose: Pick by the device's role and keep the same style for the same kind of device across the diagram: boxed_tag for the main systems and servers, tag for systems drawn as a picture (cloud, server, PC), label for network gear and secondary devices, caption for repeated small devices such as cameras, sensors and lights.

boxed_tag.layout: Icon centred inside a node box, the name tag below it; vertical stack, centred.

tag.use: Systems drawn as a picture, such as a cloud server, server rack or industrial PC.
tag.layout: Icon with no box, the name tag directly below; vertical stack, centred.

label.use: Network gear and secondary devices: switches, LIUs, routers, gateways.
label.layout: Icon with no box or tag, the name below as plain text, centred, at most 2 lines.

caption.use: Repeated small devices: cameras, sensors, lights, meters.
caption.layout: Icon with a short caption beside or below it, left-aligned to the icon.

node_styles.icons: Every style uses an icon from the Faclon architecture icon library; none is drawn or substituted.

status.when: only when the user marks a flow as a status

arrows.other: Any other arrow colour is used only when the user defines it for that diagram; otherwise the default applies.

icons.source: Faclon architecture icon library: get_brand_guidelines(section: "assets", asset_category: "icons"). 199 icons in 14 groups (energy meters, gateways and nodes, sensors, PLCs, switches and LIUs, enclosures, machines, I/O Sense platform and more), exported from the Figma icons_architecture page.
icons.missing: If a device the user names has no icon in the library, ask the user; do not pick, draw or substitute icons.

final_outcome.choose: Faclon scope by default; Faclon scope with funnel when the diagram feeds into it from the left; steam trap only for steam-trap diagrams, because its text is steam-trap specific.
final_outcome.placement: The end of the diagram, where the main data flow arrives (usually the right-hand side).

size.scale: Scale the outcome image uniformly (never crop, stretch or redraw it) so its body text matches the diagram text: scale = the density's diagram text size (12, 14 or 16px) ÷ the outcome's native body_text. At Medium, Faclon scope is 386 × 700.
size.max_width: At most a quarter of the content width (456px), the funnel included. If the funnel version would be wider, use the plain Faclon scope.
size.max_height: No taller than the input side of the diagram it closes; centre it on the main data flow.
size.balance: The input side is the larger part of the diagram: devices, zones and connections fill at least the remaining three quarters of the content width. If the outcome would still dominate, step the whole diagram's text down one density (the outcome scales down with it); never enlarge the outcome to fill space.

final_outcome.rule: Place one outcome file unchanged. Change, restyle, reword or rebuild it only when the user asks.

colour.brand_blue: Only inside the final outcome. Nothing else in the diagram uses brand/500 or a darker blue: no container/brand, background/brand, border/brand, text/brand, text/link, text/info, text/eyebrow or brand/500 to brand/1000.
colour.rest: Neutrals (background/primary canvas, container/primary, border/strong, text/heading, text/body, text/secondary) and light blue tints only: container/selected and background/brand-subtle (brand/050), container/info (brand/100), brand/200, brand/300, brand/400.
